title: Your story is part of the journey too.
description: Note how you feel, what helps, and what you want to remember. These notes are yours alone.
descriptionLive: Your entries are saved to your account. No one else sees them from this screen.
descriptionDemo: This view uses local examples to show the space. Nothing is sent to your account.
quotes: Each note is a way of knowing yourself a little better.
You do not need to write a lot. Honest and brief is enough.
Noticing is not judging. It is giving yourself a moment of clarity.
consentSaveError: To save an entry, first allow Soma to keep your wellbeing data.

summary.streakHelp: Consecutive days with at least one note. Breaking the run has no penalty.
summary.wellbeingHint: How you have felt, over the last four weeks.
summary.wellbeingHelp: Average of the 0–10 ratings you chose. It is not a clinical score.

overview.calendarHint: Days with a note are marked.
overview.calendarHelp: Empty days are not flagged or penalized.
overview.calendarMonthEmpty: This month has no notes. Empty days are not marked.
overview.evolutionHint: How your wellbeing has moved, from what you wrote down.
overview.evolutionHelp: Last 28 days. Each point is the mean of that day's ratings. Gaps are not filled. It is not a clinical score.
overview.evolutionEmpty: When you note how you feel, the line will appear here.
overview.emotionsHint: What you have tagged most often.
overview.emotionsHelp: Share of tagged entries that include each emotion. Totals may exceed 100%, because one note can carry several tags.
overview.emotionsEmpty: When you tag emotions on your entries, they will appear here by frequency.
overview.lastEmpty: There is no recent entry yet.
overview.lastPhotoHint: Decorative image. It is not a photo of you.
overview.highlightsEmpty: Mark an entry as highlighted when you want to return to it.
overview.learningsEmpty: Mark an entry as a learning to gather what helps you.
overview.milestonesHint: The improvements you have noticed in everyday life.
overview.milestonesHelp: You record them yourself. They are not medals or abstinence days.
overview.milestonesEmpty: When you want, log a perceived improvement.

entries.empty: No entries yet. You can start with a short note, an emotion, or how you slept.
entries.dayEmpty: This day has no notes. You can write one whenever you like.
entries.filterEmpty: No entries match these filters. You can widen the dates or clear the marks.

patterns.title: Patterns
patterns.evolutionHint: One scale at a time, from what you wrote down.
patterns.evolutionHelp: Each point is the mean of that day's ratings. Days without a rating are not filled in. It is not a clinical score or a prediction.
patterns.emptyNone: When you rate this scale, the line will appear here.
patterns.emptySingle: There is one day with a rating. Another day would show a line, without that meaning a trend.
patterns.coincidencesHint: Overlaps describe your records; they do not mean a situation causes an emotion.
patterns.coincidencesEmpty: There are not enough overlaps to show yet. The same pair of tags needs to appear in at least three notes.

emotionsTab.title: Emotions
emotionsTab.hint: Frequencies from your full history: what you have tagged on your entries.
emotionsTab.help: These frequencies use your full history. Percentages use entries that have at least one tag in this group. One note can carry several, so totals may exceed 100%.
emotionsTab.triggersEmpty: When you tag triggers, they will appear here by frequency.
emotionsTab.relatedEmpty: There are no entries with this tag.
emotionsTab.selectHint: Choose an emotion or a trigger to see the related notes.

milestones.saveError: The milestone could not be saved.

form.wellbeing: How would you rate your overall wellbeing today?
form.wellbeingHint: A personal 0–10 impression. It is not a diagnosis and is not computed from the other scales.
form.title: Title
form.deleteConfirmBody: This note will leave your journal. This cannot be undone from this screen.
form.deleteError: Could not delete. Please try again.
form.required: Add at least one detail: wellbeing, a scale, an emotion, a trigger, a title, or some text.
form.saveError: Could not save. Please try again.

error: The journal could not be loaded.
emptyOverview: When you are ready, leave a first note. The streak is only informational and there is no average you must hit.

demo-journal-1.title: One day closer
demo-journal-1.body: I have felt calmer today. I slept better and my mind was clearer.

demo-journal-1b.title: In the morning
demo-journal-1b.body: I noted how the day started. Later I wrote again.

demo-journal-2.title: Evening walk
demo-journal-2.body: A short walk helped me slow down. I noted what felt good.

demo-journal-3.body: A steady day. I could focus on a task I had put off.

demo-journal-4.title: More energy in the afternoon
demo-journal-4.body: A short nap and a glass of water helped more than I expected.

demo-journal-5.body: A difficult conversation, but I left clearer than I arrived.

demo-journal-6.body: A heavier day. The craving showed up and passed. It does not have to be read as a failure.

demo-journal-7.title: Walking helps
demo-journal-7.body: Going outside eased the tiredness. I want to remember that.

demo-journal-8.body: I feel more energy and want to pick up projects again.

demo-journal-9.title: A shorter night
demo-journal-9.body: I slept less, but I noted how I felt on waking.

demo-journal-10.body: A simple day. It was enough to notice myself without asking for more.

demo-journal-11.title: Midday clarity
demo-journal-11.body: I could read with attention. That counts too.

demo-journal-12.body: An uneven week. I keep recording without demanding a perfect streak.

demo-journal-prev-month.title: A month further back
demo-journal-prev-month.body: This note sits in another month so the calendar can be browsed.

demo-journal-older-month.title: A couple of months ago
demo-journal-older-month.body: An older note, to see another month with a record.

milestones.clarity: I notice more clarity when I think calmly.
milestones.rest: I have rested better for a couple of nights.
milestones.lessAnxiety: The anxiety appears and eases sooner.
milestones.focus: I can hold my attention a little longer.
milestones.emotionalStability: The day feels a bit more steady.
